primary_metric: per-seed mean accuracy over clean, noise .2/.4/.6, dropout .05/.15/.30, and joint (.4,.15)/(.6,.30) on held-out test split; then mean across seeds
candidate: full 128D (56 horizontal + 56 vertical differences + 16 2x2 means), four fixed train corruption variants, StandardScaler on augmented training features, RBF SVC C=10 gamma=scale
control: raw normalized 64D pixels with identical augmentation, scaler fitting rule, SVC and splits
pass_rule: exploratory support only if mean paired test delta full-minus-raw exceeds +0.005 and full wins on at least 2/3 individual seeds; otherwise no_gain. This is not a significance test.
